title: Boundary Geometry Turns Entanglement into Steering
summary: Quantum entanglement does not necessarily imply Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering. We identify a \emph{boundary mechanism} that closes this gap when an entangled state meets the boundary of the trusted state space in a nondegenerate way. The mechanism is local: a projective assemblage that approaches a boundary contact with first-order tangential coherence but only second-order inward defect cannot be reproduced by any finite-measure local-hidden-state model.
